text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-4823 fired for service `inference-routing` — sustained 5xx spike (~10% errors) and p95 latency jump over 2m. Region: eu-west-1. Primary: carmen. Escalation: inference-oncall -> sam (secondary) -> maria (manager). Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-4823

pd-bot: PD-4823 page sent to primary (carmen) at 2026-03-14T10:07:58Z — no ack within 3m window, auto-escalation triggered to secondary (sam).

pd-bot: Escalation fired: secondary sam paged at 2026-03-14T10:11:05Z. If no ack, will escalate to manager maria at +5m.

sam: acked PD-4823 :white_check_mark: — jumping in. seeing increased 502/503 from routing-proxy behind the model-router.

sam: quick checks: `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=routing-proxy -o wide` shows 2/6 pods in CrashLoopBackOff.

sam: pulling logs now — running `kubectl -n prod logs -l app=routing-proxy --tail=300 | grep -i error | head`

sam: logs show downstream timeouts to `model-backend-01` around 10:05:xx. also a flurry of `kvcache` evictions in the same window.

sam: mitigation plan: 1) scale routing-proxy to +3 replicas 2) restart pods in rolling manner 3) flip routing policy to fallback-model variant for critical tenants. starting step 1 now.

sam: scaling: `kubectl -n prod scale deploy routing-proxy --replicas=9` — done.

sam: restarting failing pods one at a time: `kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/routing-proxy`

sam: temporarily enabling fallback-model route for high-traffic customers (route id: fallback-2026-03-14). applying config.

maria: @sam thanks — are customers impacted? need a quick customer-impact estimate and ETA for recovery so support can prepare comms.

sam: early estimate: ~12% of requests in eu-west-1 hitting 5xx, mostly non-critical tenants but two mid-market customers saw degraded responses. ETA for stabilizing ~6-8 minutes if restarts succeed.

jason: adding for handoff — I'll shadow for postmortem / root cause. please drop timeline and exact cmds so I can capture.

sam: timeline so far: 10:05 UTC — cache invalidation job kicked off; 10:07 — PD alert fired; 10:11 — escalated to me; 10:12 — scaled to 9 replicas; 10:13 — rolling restarts started; 10:17 — traffic reroute to fallback-model applied.

sam: command snippets used:
```
# scale
kubectl -n prod scale deploy routing-proxy --replicas=9
# restart
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/routing-proxy
# apply fallback
rdctl routes apply --id fallback-2026-03-14 --target fallback-model
```

maria: good. assign follow-ups: 1) get KV cache telemetry for the invalidation job (owner: platform-team) 2) verify rate limit backpressure wasn't triggered for tenants (owner: infra) 3) add a canary/safety check around cache invalidation jobs (owner: eng-ml). please assign and ETA 24h.

sam: will open follow-up tickets and ping owners. creating incident record now.

incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-03-14-4823, severity: Sev2 (customer-impacting, partial). Link: https://incidents.example/INC-2026-03-14-4823

jason: grabbing logs and snapshots for postmortem. also will pull PagerDuty timeline (missed ack -> escalation) to include in RCA.

maria: also post an interim status note in #customer-status and loop in support leads. Sam/Jason, please DM me the short blurb for support.

sam: status blurb: "We observed a transient routing layer failure in eu-west-1 that caused ~10% 5xx for a subset of traffic. Rolling restart and routing fallback applied; impact reduced. Engineers are investigating root cause (likely cache invalidation job interaction)."

jason: thanks — I copied that to #customer-status. leaving thread for now; will follow up with timeline + RCA draft.

sam: final note — no further automatic escalations required. monitoring closely. :eyes:
